title: नेपाली सञ्चार माध्यममा पत्रकार आचारसंहिताको प्रयोगको अवस्था र सुधारका क्षेत्र {The Situation of using Journalistic Code of Ethics in Nepali Media and areas for Improvement}
nepali: नेपाली पत्रकारिता व्यवसायिकतातर्फ उन्मुख भएपनि यो संकमणकालीन अवस्थामा छ । सञ्चार माध्यमहरुको संख्या बढिरहेको सन्दर्भमा तिनीहरुमा अनुशासनको परिपाटी बसाउन आचारसंहिता परिपालना आवश्यक हुन्छ । आचारसंहिताको पालनाले पत्रकारितालाई नैतिक र जिम्मेवार बनाउँछ । पत्रकारिताको स्तर उकास्छ र अतिरिक्तजन विश्वास बढाउँछ । स्वच्छ, स्वस्थ र मर्यादित पत्रकारिता विकासका लागि सञ्चारकर्मी तथा पत्रकार, नागरिकसमाज र सरोकारवाला निकायको भूमिका महत्वपूर्ण हुन्छ । त्यसैले प्रस्तुत लेख मार्फत नेपालमा पत्रकार आचारसंहिताको परिपालनाको स्थिति र गर्नुपर्ने सुधारका बारेमा जानकारी दिने कोशिस गरिएको छ । समीक्षात्मक टिप्पणीमा आधारित यो लेखले प्रलेख वा कागजात विश्लेषण र अन्तर्वार्तालाई आधार बनाएर बनाएको छ । यसवाट पत्रकार आचारसंहिताको कार्यान्वयनको क्षेत्रमा क्रियाशील संस्था प्रेस काउन्सिल नेपालको भूमिकालाई पनि चित्रण गरेको छ ।
american_english: Nepali journalism is moving toward professionalism, but it is in a transitional state. In the context of the increasing number of media outlets, adherence to a code of conduct is necessary to establish a culture of discipline in them. Adherence to the code of ethics makes journalism ethical and responsible. It raises the standard of journalism and increases public trust. For the development of clean, healthy and dignified journalism, the role of media workers and journalists, civil society and concerned bodies is important. Therefore, through this article, an effort has been made to provide information about the situation of adherence to the journalistic code of ethics in Nepal and the improvements that need to be made. This article, based on critical commentary, has been prepared on the basis of document or record analysis and interviews. Through this, the role of the Press Council Nepal, the institution active in the field of implementing the journalistic code of ethics, has also been portrayed.

informal_english: Nepali journalism is heading towards being a proper profession, but it's still in a transitional phase. With more and more media outlets popping up, you need a code of conduct to build a culture of discipline in them. Sticking to the code of ethics makes journalism ethical and responsible. It lifts the standard of journalism and builds public trust. For clean, healthy and dignified journalism to develop, media workers and journalists, civil society and the bodies concerned all have a part to play. So through this article, we've tried to give a sense of where adherence to the journalistic code of ethics stands in Nepal and what needs improving. This piece, based on critical commentary, draws on document and record analysis and interviews. Through it, the role of the Press Council Nepal - the body active in implementing the journalistic code of ethics - is also sketched out.
